## What and why

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] Tests for behaviour changes (runtime) and type changes (`tests/types`)
- [ ] TSDoc, docs pages and `examples/` updated where relevant
- [ ] A changeset (`npx changeset`, or `npx changeset --empty` for docs/tests/CI)
- [ ] Breaking changes: a section in `docs/migration/0.x-to-1.0.md`, linked from the changeset
